turns.speaker: D
turns.text: Good afternoon, please have a seat and tell me what brings you in today.

turns.speaker: D
turns.text: How long have you been feeling this way, and does anything make it better?

turns.speaker: D
turns.text: I would like to check your blood pressure and listen to your heart now.

turns.speaker: D
turns.text: Are you taking any medication regularly, including vitamins or supplements?

turns.speaker: D
turns.text: That is helpful, thank you. I will order a few tests and we will review them together.

turns.speaker: D
turns.text: Please come back in two weeks, or sooner if the symptoms get worse.
